logline: Publicly cast aside at the altar by Gerald for her sister Clarissa and abandoned by her own family, Juliana stands tall and turns her public humiliation into an unyielding indictment of Gerald's honor.

lines.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
lines.en: I cannot marry you, Juliana.

lines.en: You are far too plain...

lines.en: Gerald... Look at me.

dubfit.text: जेराल्ड... मेरी ओर देखो।

lines.en: You gave me your word before both our families.

lines.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines.en: Father...

lines.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines.en: Surely you will not let him humiliate me like this?

lines.en: Do not disgrace us further.
